name: Wheelchair
logline_subject_info: The modern, non-hospital wheelchair used by the Elderly Man.
visual_desc: A three-quarter view of a modern, high-quality manual wheelchair. It has a lightweight, black carbon-fiber frame, not chrome. The seat and backrest are made of a durable black nylon fabric. The large rear wheels have thin, ergonomic push-rims. The smaller front casters are solid and sleek. The armrests are padded and unobtrusive. It looks comfortable and functional, not clinical or institutional. The object is displayed against a blank, solid deep-charcoal background with soft studio lighting, and is empty.
video_visual_desc: A modern, empty manual wheelchair with a lightweight black carbon-fiber frame and black nylon seating.
